summary: Estrellas developed MARS PATH, an interactive website about Mars where, for example, you can view an interactive map of the route we suggest using on Mars and another map for plotting routes, as well as a section with information about Mars such as environmental conditions, geological features, science points, etc.
details:
What it does and how it works:
MARS PATH is an interactive website with information, routes, and maps of Mars. It includes an interactive map of the route we suggest using on Mars and a second map where users can plot their own routes. It also has an interactive menu with essential information for your next exploration.

Benefits:
When you plot a route, MARS PATH tells you whether it is safe and whether you can take it, and explains the reasons why or why not. Our goal is to help you choose a route that is safe and beneficial for you.

Intended impact:
We want future explorers to plan their journeys with confidence, using reliable information and clear safety guidance.

Tools and technologies:
We developed MARS PATH using JavaScript, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), HyperText Markup Language (HTML), and information provided by NASA.

Creativity:
Instead of only presenting information about Mars, MARS PATH lets users interact with it: they explore maps, plot their own routes, and receive immediate feedback on whether those routes are safe.

Factors our team considered:
Team Estrellas considered the needs of future Mars explorers. We prioritized their safety when plotting routes, and we focused on providing verified, essential information they can rely on.
